title: How to Reset Your Password
content: To reset your password: 1. Click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. 2. Enter your email address. 3. Check your email for a password reset link (check spam folder if not found). 4. Click the link and set a new password. 5. Your password will be updated immediately. If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, try requesting again or contact our support team.

title: Refund Policy
content: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, simply contact our support team within 30 days of your purchase date with your order number. We'll process your refund within 5-7 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Some items may have different return policies - check your order details for specifics.

title: Track Your Order
content: You can track your order in real-time through your account dashboard. 1. Log in to your account. 2. Navigate to 'My Orders'. 3. Click on the order number to see tracking details. 4. You'll see the current status, estimated delivery date, and tracking number for shipping carriers. You can also use the tracking number to follow your package directly with the carrier's website. Email notifications are sent automatically at each step.

title: Payment Methods Accepted
content: We accept the following payment methods: Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), Debit Cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for large orders. All payments are processed securely using industry-standard encryption. We do not store your full credit card information - it's processed through secure payment gateways. For any payment issues, contact our billing team at billing@company.com.

title: Subscription Plans
content: We offer three subscription tiers: Basic ($9.99/month) - includes 5 projects and basic support. Pro ($29.99/month) - includes unlimited projects and priority email support. Enterprise (custom pricing) - includes everything plus dedicated account manager and phone support. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan anytime. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle. Annual subscriptions receive a 20% discount.

title: How to Delete Your Account
content: To delete your account permanently: 1. Log in to your account. 2. Go to Settings → Account Settings. 3. Scroll to the bottom and click 'Delete Account'. 4. Enter your password to confirm. 5. Click 'Permanently Delete' - this action cannot be undone. Your personal data will be deleted within 24 hours. Some activity logs may be retained for legal purposes. If you change your mind, contact support within 30 days to recover your account.

title: Billing Issues and Disputes
content: If you notice an unauthorized charge or billing error: 1. Contact our billing team immediately at billing@company.com with your order number. 2. Provide a detailed explanation of the issue. 3. We'll investigate within 2 business days. 4. For credit card disputes, contact your bank to initiate a chargeback - we'll cooperate with the bank's investigation. Legitimate billing errors are corrected immediately and refunded in full. We take billing disputes seriously and resolve them fairly.

title: API Documentation
content: We provide a comprehensive REST API for developers. Base URL: api.company.com/v1. All endpoints require authentication using API keys. Get your API key from your account dashboard under 'Developers' → 'API Keys'. Rate limits: 1000 requests per hour for standard accounts, unlimited for Enterprise. Detailed documentation available at docs.company.com/api. SDKs available for Python, JavaScript, and Go.
